name: 82072 · Laramie, WY
findings: ZIP 82072 (Laramie) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82072 (Laramie) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
